Node.js native Nacos addon using napi-rs and nacos-sdk-rust. Rust: `src/*.rs`; `lib.rs` entry/`ClientOptions`; `config.rs` config client; `naming.rs` discovery; `plugin.rs` config filters. `index.d.ts` is auto-generated. Async methods return Promises; `Option<T>` maps to `T | undefined | null`; subscriptions use `ThreadsafeFunction`; Nacos errors become JS `Error`.

Toolchain: Cargo, napi-rs, Yarn 3.4.1. Build: `yarn build:debug`; target build: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`. CI: `.github/workflows/CI.yml`. Outputs: `nacos-sdk-rust-binding-node.<platform>.node`, `index.d.ts`. AVA test: `yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs`. Tests require the native addon to be built first (`index.node` must exist).

Environment: `NACOS_CLIENT_LOGGER_LEVEL` (default `INFO`, logs to `$HOME/logs/nacos/`); `NACOS_CLIENT_COMMON_THREAD_CORES` (default `1`); `NACOS_CLIENT_NAMING_PUSH_EMPTY_PROTECTION` (default `true`).

`removeListener/unSubscribe` are NOOPs: Rust SDK does not implement removal. Clients maintain persistent gRPC connections; create once and reuse. Auth supports username/password HTTP tokens or Alibaba Cloud RAM access_key/access_secret. Build dependency: require `nacos-sdk-rust` and `napi`. If build fails, ensure Rust toolchain is up to date: `rustup update stable && cargo update`. For cross-compilation, consult CI Docker setup; addon loading errors may indicate platform/architecture mismatch.
